sentences.text: 3. Heard learned advocates appearing for the respective parties.

4. Mr. Rajat R. Gadhvi, learned advocate appearing for the applicants submits that pursuant to the registration of the FIR, investigation was carried out and ultimately, at the end of day, charge-sheet was submitted before the competent court, which culminated into Criminal Case No.15488 of 2024.
As soon as the said fact came to the knowledge of the applicants, they have approached this Hon'ble Court by way of preferring present application.

Learned advocate further submits that during the pendency of present proceedings, the matter has already been settled between the parties and the complainant is not willing to carry out the proceedings further.
The complainant has filed affidavit specifically stating the said fact that if the proceedings of present complaint is quashed, in that event, she has no objection.
An affidavit to that effect has also been filed by the complainant.

It is,
therefore, urged that the present applications may be allowed.

5. Learned advocate Ms. Shivani Modi, for the respondent no.2 - original complainant has submitted that the respondent no.2 - complainant has personally remained present before this court through virtual mode and she has no objection, if the proceedings qua the present applicants would be quashed.

Learned advocate further submits that the disputes is settled between the parties and an affidavit in that regard is already NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/7121/2025 ORDER DATED:
08/04/2025 undefined filed by the complainant.

Learned advocate has identified the signature of the complainant as well as identified the respondent no.2 - original complainant, who is personally present before this Court through virtual mode and also confirmed correctness and genuineness of the affidavit filed by her.
6. Learned APP has submitted that appropriate order may be passed on the strength of the settlement arrived at between the parties.

7. Therefore, since now, the dispute with reference to the impugned FIR is settled and resolved by and between parties, which is confirmed by the original complainant through his learned advocate,
the trial would be futile and any further continuation of proceedings would amount to abuse of process of law.
Therefore, the impugned FIR is required to be quashed and set aside.
The affidavit filed by the respondent no.2- original complainant is ordered to be taken on record.
8. Resultantly, the present application is allowed.

The proceedings of the Criminal Case No.15488 of 2024 pending before the Court of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Rajkot arising out from the FIR being C.R. No.11208001240046 of 2024 registered with Mahila Police Station, Rajkot City and all other consequential proceedings arising out of said complaint are hereby quashed and set aside qua the applicants herein.
NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/7121/2025 ORDER DATED: 08/04/2025 undefined Rule is made absolute to the aforesaid extent.
